Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
8:36 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 7 or Core i5/i7 chip. That matters more than a flashy graphics card.

Windows or Linux, all-round: Lenovo ThinkPad or IdeaPad Pro, or ASUS Zenbook, with a Ryzen 7. They have good keyboards and long battery life.
Apple: a MacBook Air with an M-series chip is great for coding, but it only fits if you find it on sale near this budget. I haven't checked current prices.
Only if you do game or AI work: a laptop with a basic graphics card, though battery life will be shorter.

Skip anything with 8 GB RAM that can't be upgraded, and avoid screens below full HD.

What do you mostly code in: web apps, Android, or data and AI?
